description: Defines the EvdevInjector class for simulating evdev input devices, including configuration, error handling, and event sending methods.

classes.name: EvdevInjector
classes.description: A class for simulating evdev input devices, managing configuration, error states, and event injection.

classes.name: UInput
classes.description: A nested class providing an interface to /dev/uinput for testing purposes.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the input device and releases resources.

methods.name: GetError
methods.description: Returns the current error state.

methods.name: ResetError
methods.description: Resets the error state to zero.

methods.name: ConfigureBegin
methods.description: Starts configuration of the evdev device with basic properties.

methods.name: ConfigureInputProperty
methods.description: Configures an optional input device property.

methods.name: ConfigureKey
methods.description: Configures an input key or button.

methods.name: ConfigureAbs
methods.description: Configures an absolute axis with range and fuzz parameters.

methods.name: ConfigureAbsSlots
methods.description: Sets the number of multitouch slots.

methods.name: ConfigureMultiTouchXY
methods.description: Sets multitouch coordinate range.

methods.name: ConfigureRel
methods.description: Configures a relative axis.

methods.name: ConfigureEnd
methods.description: Completes configuration and creates the input device.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends an input event.

methods.name: SendSynReport
methods.description: Sends a synchronization report.

methods.name: SendKey
methods.description: Sends a key event.

methods.name: SendAbs
methods.description: Sends an absolute axis event.

methods.name: SendRel
methods.description: Sends a relative axis event.

methods.name: SendMultiTouchSlot
methods.description: Selects a multitouch slot.

methods.name: SendMultiTouchXY
methods.description: Sends multitouch coordinate data.

methods.name: SendMultiTouchLift
methods.description: Lifts a multitouch contact.

methods.name: dumpInternal
methods.description: Outputs internal state information for debugging.

methods.name: SetUInputForTesting
methods.description: Sets a UInput instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetUiDevForTesting
methods.description: Returns the uinput_user_dev structure for testing.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Sets the error state if not already set.

methods.name: RequireState
methods.description: Checks if the injector is in the required state.

methods.name: EnableEventType
methods.description: Enables an event type if necessary.
